metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the macos-def:systemprofiler_test is properly supported
metadata.description: The definition should evalutate to true if the tool supports the macos-def:systemprofiler_test properly.

notes.note: This definition checks the functionality of the macos-def:systemprofiler_test and may require adjustment of the systemprofiler_object or systemprofiler_state paramaters based on the configuration of the system being tested.

criterion.comment: Test that the systemprofiler_object is supported with the datatype entity not equal to some value.
Test that the systemprofiler_object is supported with the datatype entity matching some regular expression.

systemprofiler_test.comment: Test that the systemprofiler_object is supported with the datatype entity equal to some value.
Test that the systemprofiler_object is supported with the datatype entity not equal to some value.
Test that the systemprofiler_object is supported with the datatype entity matching a regular expression.

systemprofiler_object.comment: Retrieve item(s) for data_type operation of equals.
Retrieve item(s) for data_type operation of not equal.
Retrieve item(s) for data_type operation of pattern match.

systemprofiler_state.comment: Confirm item contents are as expected.
